summary: Far: in space, in time, and in the length of a road still to walk.
placement: Chosen by farthest-point sampling on the integrated Burke–Shaw trajectory, so the eight stars spread across its projected shape. 遠 takes the point farthest from the system’s centre, 孤 the most isolated of the rest, and 寂 the point nearest the centre. A design choice, not a claim.

satellites.title: Far Roaming
satellites.evidence: Yuanyou: 悲時俗之迫阨兮，願輕舉而遠遊 … 惟天地之無窮兮，哀人生之長勤。往者余弗及兮，來者吾不聞 — “grieving the narrowness of the age, I long to rise lightly and roam far … heaven and earth have no end; I mourn the long toil of human life. Those gone before I cannot reach; those yet to come I will not hear.”
satellites.caveat: Traditionally ascribed to Qu Yuan; many scholars date it later.
